description: The Mopo project deposits a Baltic-region renewable-generation package with higher geographic detail than its pan-European VRE release. Its own page says the data include hourly solar photovoltaic and onshore or offshore wind simulations, a map of onshore polygons and an additional five-minute wind run. The high-frequency run extends hourly wind speeds using a stochastic method and covers representative existing and selected future turbines. Zenodo lists one public 523 MB ZIP under CC BY 4.0. These profiles could test Baltic electricity balancing, storage or congestion scenarios at finer spatial and temporal scales. A limitation is that they are simulated availability, not metered turbine output, and the provider notes that no existing offshore wind was included for the Baltic countries. The ZIP was not downloaded, so polygon definitions, country-year coverage and file-level values remain unchecked. This is a distinct regional and five-minute release, not a duplicate of the broader Mopo VRE package. No related catalogue record explicitly covers it.
